result.instructions: Tools for Voyage AI, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Embed these 20 support articles as documents so I can search them later."; "Rerank these 15 search results against my customer's question and show the top 5."; "List my Batch API jobs and tell me which ones are still in progress.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Voyage AI data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run voyage_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run voyage_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run voyage_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. voyage_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: voyage_create_embeddings
tools.title: Create text embeddings
tools.description: Turn one text or a list of up to 128 texts into embedding vectors with a Voyage text model (for example voyage-4, voyage-4-large, voyage-4-lite, voyage-3.5). Use input_type 'query' or 'document' for search. Billed by tokens. Voyage API: POST /embeddings.

input.description: A text, or a list of up to 128 texts.

model.description: Model name, for example voyage-4 or voyage-3.5.

input_type.description: Set 'query' for search queries, 'document' for indexed documents.

output_dimension.description: Embedding size. Only some models accept other sizes (voyage-3-large and voyage-code-3: 256, 512, 1024, 2048).

truncation.description: Cut texts that are too long for the model context (default true). false makes an over-long text an error.

tools.name: voyage_rerank
tools.title: Rerank documents
tools.description: Score a list of up to 1000 documents against a query with a Voyage reranker (rerank-2 or rerank-2-lite) and return them ordered by relevance. Billed by tokens. Voyage API: POST /rerank.

model.description: Reranker model, for example rerank-2 or rerank-2-lite.

top_k.description: Return only the top K results. Default: all documents.

return_documents.description: Include the document text in each result (default false: index and score only).

truncation.description: Cut query and documents that are too long for the reranker (default true).

tools.name: voyage_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List files uploaded to the organization for the Batch API, newest first by default. Optional purpose filter and cursor pagination. Voyage API: GET /files.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (1-10000).

after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page.

tools.name: voyage_get_file
tools.title: Get a file
tools.description: Get metadata for one uploaded file by id (size, purpose, status). Voyage API: GET /files/{file_id}.

tools.name: voyage_list_batches
tools.title: List batches
tools.description: List Batch API jobs for the organization, with their status and request counts. Voyage API: GET /batches.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (1-10000).

after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page.

tools.name: voyage_get_batch
tools.title: Get a batch
tools.description: Get one Batch API job by id: status (validating, in_progress, completed, failed, cancelling, cancelled), request counts and output file ids. Voyage API: GET /batches/{batch_id}.

tools.name: voyage_cancel_batch
tools.title: Cancel a batch
tools.description: Cancel a Batch API job that is validating or in progress. The job moves to cancelling for up to 10 minutes, then cancelled. Other states cannot be cancelled. Voyage API: POST /batches/{batch_id}/cancel.
